title: Codec Plugin and Alias-Set API
negative_results: require_unique_pin refuses a multi-candidate alias set (invariant 4) by delegating to claims.refuse_alias_as_unique
require_unique_pin refuses an empty alias set (nothing to pin)
an empty alias set is a legal result when no legacy codec admits the raw input
register refuses a non-conforming object (missing encode/decode) and a duplicate codec id
absent codec modules (codec_pack40, codec_pack38) are skipped by discovery, not required

claims.statement: CodecRegistry registers any codec exposing codec_id, version, encode, decode; the default registry discovers available modules with per-module try/except and is decoupled from specific codec imports.
decode_all runs every registered legacy codec and returns an AliasSet of 0..N LEGACY_ALIAS_CANDIDATE decodes, each with a score, an uncertainty, and a search-space count.
The API never forces one pin: a single pin requested from a multi-candidate or empty set is refused (System Contract invariant 4).

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
